title: Overlap 90 % (a new 200 ms window every 20 ms) · 4th-order envelope
description: First round, 4th-order envelope low-pass (about 230 ms lag); kept for comparison with the 2nd-order round. Training uses every 2nd window, so consecutive training windows share 90 % of their steps (half as many training windows). Validation and test keep every window. Everything else as the reference: Active torque (each session's own relaxed-hold passive torque subtracted), EMG ÷ session-1 maximum, per-angle loss scaling, LSTM 8×2 trained with batch 64 (fast protocol: learning rate × 0.5 after 6 flat epochs, early stop 15, at most 150 epochs), trained on session 1 and tested on session 2, 6 people × 10 seeds. The EMG envelope is causal (forward-only filters: no input uses later EMG, as in a real-time device) and the first and last 1 s of every trial are cut. Caveat: fewer training windows also means proportionally fewer weight updates per epoch, under the same epoch limit and early stopping, so this setting changes the amount of training as well as the overlap.
